expression: z=(1-fx)(1-fy)z00+fx(1-fy)z10+(1-fx)fy*z01+fx*fy*z11, with XYZ pixel-centre coordinates shifted by 0.5
preconditions: Query inside the open outer edge of the XYZ matrix
decisionLogic: Fetch the four neighbouring pixel centres even when they cross a tile boundary.
Return NoData if any required tile or elevation sample is unavailable.
Record whether NearestPixel or BilinearPixelCentres was used.
For a priority DEM stack, use all required pixels from one source; never blend resolution/source layers within one bilinear result.
uncertainty: Bilinear resampling does not increase source DEM resolution or survey accuracy
exclusions: No extrapolation beyond the XYZ matrix
validationMethod: Analytic linear field across an XYZ tile edge, missing tile, wrong raster kind and adaptive-route integration tests
reopenCondition: Source-specific interpolation guidance, cubic resampling or quantified DEM error propagation is required
